rows.definition: ctxmmu.ExpertResidencyPolicy (internal/ctxmmu/expert_residency.go) is the MoE expert-residency policy for the unified-memory serving tier: it holds a byte-budgeted resident hot-set LRU ring and a separate bounded transient prefill ring over a ResidencyBacking store, deciding per touch whether a routed expert's weights sit resident, transient, or cold. Prefill touches stage cold descriptors only into the transient ring so a sweep can never evict the decode hot set; Decode promotes a transient hit into the hot set by descriptor swap with no payload re-read, and loads a cold miss into the hot set. WarmStart seeds the hot set from a frequency-ranked access trace and Stats() reports the hit/miss/promotion/eviction accounting.
rows.distinction: It is the policy TYPE owning the two rings and their admission logic - not its two constructors, not the ExpertResidencyAdvisor interface it consults, and not the offline KVEvictPolicy replay labels or the model-side ExpertRingEvictPolicy victim ranking. Its 'residency' is expert-weight ring placement, not the engine-residency tool-call adjudicator residencyGate.

rows.definition: NewExpertResidencyPolicy (internal/ctxmmu/expert_residency.go) constructs an ExpertResidencyPolicy over a ResidencyBacking: it substitutes DefaultExpertHotBytes (6 GiB) and DefaultExpertTransientBytes (2 GiB) for non-positive budgets, builds the two expertLRURings, and leaves the advisor field nil. With no advisor, cold-miss decode admission is plain LRU - every admitted cold touch becomes resident, DecodeBypasses stays 0, and no advisor warm-start source exists. A nil backing is admitted because a synthetic warm-start caller may supply descriptors through Load anyway.
rows.distinction: The BASE constructor: plain-LRU admission with no advisor, differing from NewExpertResidencyPolicyWithAdvisor only in leaving the advisor field nil. It is not the policy type itself, not the advisor-decorated variant, and not the offline eviction replay (ReplayKVCache) that KVEvictPolicy selects.

rows.definition: NewExpertResidencyPolicyWithAdvisor (internal/ctxmmu/expert_residency_advisor.go) builds an ExpertResidencyPolicy through NewExpertResidencyPolicy and then wires an ExpertResidencyAdvisor into it. The advisor gates cold-miss decode admission with its displacement band - a challenger that would evict a resident is admitted only when its heat beats the victim's, otherwise the touch is bypassed (served from backing, counted in DecodeBypasses) - and supplies the committed hot set behind WarmStartFromAdvisor, with every insert/eviction reported back via MarkResident/ClearResident. A nil advisor is equivalent to NewExpertResidencyPolicy.
rows.distinction: The ADVISOR-WIRED variant: identical to NewExpertResidencyPolicy except that the advisor's displacement band gates cold-miss decode admission and its committed hot set feeds WarmStartFromAdvisor. It is a constructor, not the ExpertResidencyAdvisor interface it accepts, not the model.ExpertHotSetAdvisor adapter that implements it, and not the offline LFU-hysteresis simulation in expert_residency_lfu.go it mirrors.
